question: According to Psalm 89:26, what will David call out to God?
options: "You are my King and my Judge"
"You are my Father, my God, the Rock my Savior"
"You are my Shepherd and my Light"
"You are my Shield and my Sword"
explanation: God says David will call out to Him, "You are my Father, my God, the Rock my Savior."
